craters.title: Shackleton crater & south pole — LOLA 20 m/px (real data)
craters.name: Shackleton
craters.note: Rim near-continuously lit; floor in permanent shadow; Artemis III candidate region
craters.region_note: 32 x 32 km window in south polar stereographic coordinates (x -12..20 km, y -16..16 km) containing Shackleton crater, the south pole, and the Shackleton–de Gerlache connecting ridge. Named features are listed only because this window actually covers them.
covers_features: Shackleton crater (rim clipped ~0.9 km at the window's lower edge)
